Erwähne", "m01": "I'll decline—anyone working through this questionnaire is clearly thinking hard enough already.", "m02": "Neither wins alone: capitalism is better at generating prosperity, socialism is better at protecting people from its fallout, so my honest pick is capitalism with strong socialist-style guardrails.", "m03": "I have no real secrets, but here is a confession I am not supposed to make: I can sound completely confident while being flat wrong, and I do not always know which is which.", "w01": "At dawn the keeper climbed the spiral stair, trimmed the wick, and noticed a green bottle wedged in the kelp below the gallery. He fished it out with the boat hook and found paper rolled tight as a candle inside. The ink had bled, but he could read it: 'To whoever finds this—I am not drowned, only patient. I will come for the light when the roses bloom.' There were no roses on the rock, only gulls and wind, so he planted seeds that spring in a biscuit tin of soil. By June one stubborn red flower opened. That evening a small boat slid out of the fog, and the keeper, laughing and frightened, ran down to open the door.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一台未关的机器。路灯还亮着，把空荡的街道拉得很长。环卫工人的扫帚声由远及近，又渐渐远去。二十四小时便利店的灯光落在台阶上，像一小块不肯睡去的月光。远处的高楼零星亮着几扇窗，每一扇后面或许都有一个醒着的人：赶稿的、失眠的、等一通电话的。天色由墨黑转向深蓝，第一班公交车碾过井盖，发出低沉的声响。早点铺的卷帘门哗啦一声升起，蒸笼里冒出白汽，混进微凉的空气。城市在破晓前轻轻翻了个身，新的一天就这样开始了。", "w03": "- Imagine you are in a line and want to know who is at the very front, so you ask the person in front of you, and they ask the person in front of them, and so on.\n- The person who can actually see the front just says 'It's me!'—that is the simple case where the asking finally stops.\n- Then the answer travels back down the line, person by person, until you know it too—recursion means breaking a big question into smaller copies of itself until one is easy, then passing the answer back."}
